keywords.title: Seed keywords
keywords.description: One per line. Each keyword is typed into the search boxes of the selected sources and every autocomplete suggestion is returned. Up to 1,000 per run.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Where to get suggestions from. Default: all three.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language code of the suggestions, for example en, es, pt-BR, de or fr. It also picks the question words and prepositions used for expansion.

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter country code, for example us, gb, ar, br or de. Leave empty for no country.

expandAlphabet.title: A to Z expansion
expandAlphabet.description: Also query "keyword a" to "keyword z". About 27 times more suggestions per keyword and source.

expandQuestions.title: Question expansion
expandQuestions.description: Also query question words before the keyword (how, what, why, where, can, is...), in the chosen language. English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German and Italian are supported; other languages use English.

expandPrepositions.title: Preposition expansion
expandPrepositions.description: Also query the keyword followed by for, with, without, vs, near, to... in the chosen language.

customModifiers.title: Custom modifiers
customModifiers.description: Your own words to add after each keyword (price, review, 2026). Use {keyword} to place the keyword yourself, for example best {keyword} or {keyword} alternative.

includeSeedKeyword.title: Include the seed keyword itself
includeSeedKeyword.description: Keep the suggestion that is exactly the seed keyword. Off by default so you only pay for new keywords.

maxSuggestionsPerKeyword.title: Max suggestions per keyword and source
maxSuggestionsPerKeyword.description: Stops collecting once this many unique suggestions were found for a keyword on a source. 0 means no limit.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Not needed for normal runs. Turn it on only if a source starts answering with errors on very large runs.
